scope: Actual operational source reconciliation. Full ZIP SHA/CRC/all member hashing is inherited from the bound LOCAL_TRANSFER_VERIFIED receipt; selected process/control/COMMIT bytes independently matched to descriptor. No duplicate whole archive pass.
limitations: Linux owner liveness is established by target FINAL_READBACK timestamp, not by local Windows PID inspection.
RSS values are sampled, not a continuous kernel-enforced maximum.
Reviewer authored driver/downloader: separate independent reviewer/root acceptance remains required.
